thread:
ana: Thanks for the all-hands today. Follow-up thread for the customer wins/losses section — post questions for leadership or asks we should prioritize. I’ll capture and route.

matt: Two quick asks — 1) customers asking for cost transparency per-route. Is there a roadmap item? 2) any update on Dedicated SLA timeline?

ana: Good ones. Cost transparency — product is putting together per-route billing export, target Q2. Dedicated SLA — we're finalizing legal; target pilot next month. Not locked.

leah: For wins: sales mentioned we won a deal because of our "fallback routing". Can we capture that as a prescriptive playbook? e.g., recommended routes + example config?

sam: +1 on playbook. Also a loss theme: customers said model regressions post-quantization caused failures. Need clearer guidance on which models to pin and how to test.

priya: Can we create a prompt-eval checklist for releases? "smoke tests" for core flows. I can volunteer to draft.

derek: Also product ask from partner: per-tenant KV cache controls and evict policy. It's blocking one POC.

jordan: Quick note — for cost transparency work, infra needs sample billing events. @matt can you share an example event or demo dataset?

matt: will upload a sanitized CSV to drive by EOD.

ana: Action items I'll own: 1) compile top 5 asks into a product/engineering triage this week, 2) create playbook draft template (leah+sam), 3) share timeline for SLA/cost work. Priya — thanks for offering eval checklist draft.

allhands-bot: Ana created task: #AH-1783 "Customer feedback — wins/losses triage" assigned to ana, leah, sam, priya. Link: https://rwd.inc/tasks/AH-1783 :tada:

ops-bot: Deploy info: Dedicated pilot cluster scheduled for 2027-02-10 -> notify eng-runtime if date slips.

matt: one more — can leadership clarify threshold for handing over to sales engineering vs solutions engineering? We've had mixed signals.

ana: Good point. For now: SE handles POC until perf&security checklist done; after that sales-eng transitions to customer success. I'll write a short doc.

leah: thanks. wrapping up — anyone object to ephemeral doc in /docs/playbooks/customer-wins-losses-dig until we have a stable home?

sam: no objection. I'll sync with docs team.

ana: perfect. closing thread in 48h unless more items. :handshake:
